notes: Git cannot store FIFO/socket/device. setup.mjs builds nodes at runtime. Freeze locks construction + expected rule_id. Go register is SRC-VAL-IMPL.
order: For each case, point Agent sop at the constructed node

cases.how: ln -s demo.sop.md sops/link.sop.md (leaf is a symlink)
ln -s sops sops-link; Agent sop ./sops-link/demo.sop.md (component symlink)
mkfifo sops/fifo.sop.md (POSIX). Skip on Windows with skip_reason platform.

Bind a Unix domain socket. Darwin sun_path is ~104 bytes: setup.mjs binds under os.tmpdir()/amx-pt/<pid>/sops/s. Skip on Windows. Restricted sandboxes MAY skip with skip_reason listen_failed; expected rule_id is unchanged.
Do not create a real device node. Implementation tests MAY inject a stat() stub (mode S_IFBLK/S_IFCHR). Freeze expected remains SRC-PATH-TYPE.
